subject: Hosted API pricing: per-1M token IO and model roster for pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medivault.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token (input/output) + model roster for pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the chat earlier. We’re kicking off a small pilot to evaluate hosted LLM inference for document summarization and triage. Before we lock a pilot date, can you send a baseline per-1M token IO price split (input vs output) and the set of hosted models you’d recommend for a 3-month pilot? A few details:

- Expected traffic: ~15M tokens/month in month 1, scaling to ~60M tokens/month if pilot goes well.
- Workloads: short to medium summaries (avg input length ~250 tokens, output ~120 tokens) and some classification/reranking.
- We care about predictable unit economics more than the absolute lowest latency.

Specific asks:
- Per-1M token rates for input and output (if you price separately) for each recommended model tier (small/mid/large).
- Which hosted model names are eligible under those tiers for the hosted API and any caveats (e.g., quantized variants, max context).
- Any pilot discounts or trial credits available, and the typical committed-volume discount bands.

If you can send a one-page baseline and a short attachment we can circulate with our finance and procurement teams, that would be perfect.

Thanks,
Elaine Turner
Director of AI Engineering
MedVault, Inc.
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medivault.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token (input/output) + model roster for pilot

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and context. I’ve looped in Aditya (pricing) and Marissa (pilot onboarding) so we can get a concise baseline and an attachment you can share with procurement.

Quick clarifying Qs for the price sheet:
- Are you expecting to pin a specific model for the pilot or would you like us to recommend a default based on cost/quality tradeoffs?
- Do you require an SLA for latency or is uptime + predictable per-token pricing sufficient for finance to evaluate?

We’ll aim to get a one-page IO cost table plus a short model roster and note on discounts by tomorrow EOD PT.

—Sean
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medivault.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token (input/output) + model roster for pilot

Hi Elaine — sharing a baseline pricing snapshot and the hosted model roster we typically recommend for pilots. Attaching the short rate card for clarity (redwood_q3_ratecard_v2.pdf).

Baseline per 1M tokens (USD) — hosted API, standard endpoint (no dedicated capacity):
- Small models (0.5–4B parameters; good for classification/reranking): input $25 / 1M, output $35 / 1M
- Mid models (6–13B; good accuracy/cost tradeoff): input $75 / 1M, output $220 / 1M
- Large models (30B+; high-quality generation): input $180 / 1M, output $760 / 1M

Notes: these are IO-split prices (we bill input tokens separately from output tokens). We also publish combined per-response estimates for common prompt sizes in the attachment.

Hosted model roster (examples; availability subject to region/hardware):
- Small tier: redwood-lite-1b, mosaic-2.7b, gptj-6b-optimized
- Mid tier: redwood-7b, meta-llama-2-13b-compat, mosaic-13b-opt
- Large tier: redwood-70b-quant, meta-llama-2-70b, openai-compat-65b

Caveats and policy:
- Quantized variants (marked "-quant" or "-opt") may have slightly different throughput/latency and sometimes different per-1M rates; we call these out in the attachment.
- Max supported context lengths differ by model; we include those details in the attached roster.

Discounts / commitments:
- Pilot: we typically offer a one-time pilot credit (up to $10k) for evaluation runs — requestable on the deal.
- Volume tiers: 10–100M/mo: 5–10% off list; 100–500M/mo: 10–18% off; 500M+/mo: bespoke pricing and reserved capacity options.

Next steps: If this aligns, Marissa can run a short pilot runbook (networking, keys, sample prompts) and we can provision a short trial with the mid-tier model you choose. If you want firm SLAs or reserved throughput we can switch to a Dedicated quote.

—Aditya
Pricing & GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_q3_ratecard_v2.pdf (one-page IO table + model roster)
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medivault.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token (input/output) + model roster for pilot

Thanks Aditya — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups before I share with procurement:

1) Latency SLOs: for summaries we need 95th percentile inference under 600ms for mid-tier models at the pilot scale. Do you have standard latency figures or an SLO addendum for hosted API customers?
2) Tokenization differences: when you give per-1M rates, are those computed with our input tokens raw (we’ll be sending UTF-8 text) or do you normalize across tokenizers? We want to avoid surprises when we model costs.
3) Embeddings eligibility: if we add embedding lookups for reranking, do the same model tiers/IO rates apply or are embeddings priced differently?

Also — procurement asked if you can provide a short PO path (standard MSA + attachment list) so they can pre-approve small pilots.

If you can drop a short reply addressing (1)-(3) and a link to the MSA template, I’ll circulate it.

Best,
Elaine
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medivault.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-1M token (input/output) + model roster for pilot

Hi Elaine — quick answers:

1) Latency: for hosted API mid-tier models we publish typical p95s on our Console; pilot workloads at 60M tokens/month are usually within p95 < 600ms for 13B-class models on our standard runtime. If you need contractual SLOs we can offer an addendum or discuss Dedicated capacity. See: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/slo-hosted and I’ve dropped the link to an implementation runbook above.

2) Tokenization: billing uses the canonical tokenizer for each model (we report token counts in the Console). For planning, we can run a short tokenization sample on a representative subset of your documents and show per-response cost estimates so procurement isn’t surprised.

3) Embeddings: embeddings use a separate SKU and are priced per 1M embedding-input tokens/units; they are typically lower cost than generation output and we’ll include the exact numbers in the pilot appendix.

MSA & PO path: Marissa will share our standard MSA and a checklist of attachments (SOC 2 link, data handling notes, rate card) — she’ll also include a HubSpot draft PO template you can use. HubSpot deal id: DEAL-8743.

Marissa — can you drop the MSA link and schedule a 30-minute pilot kick-off for next week?

Thanks,
—Sean
